derivedFrom: 22.14's walk worked by hand over a constructed tape, not a run. Four members over eight sessions, the first and the fifth each month's first: A closing at 100 and rising 2 a session, B at 50 falling 1, C at 20 rising 1 and D flat at 10. On the second session A's newly read filing scores 8 of 9 against 6 before with its sales growth speeding up, and B's 7 of 9 against 5; on the third C's 9 of 9 against 9; on the sixth A's next filing reads 6 of 9. At the starting setting A alone is bought, B being under the bar of 8 and C no higher than before; on the sixth A falls under the hold of 7 and is sold at that close of 110, 110 / 102 - 1 = 7.84 per cent, against the four members answered on its night from the second session to the sixth, A 7.84, B 45 / 49 - 1 = -8.16, C 25 / 21 - 1 = 19.05 and D 0 per cent, a mean of 4.68, an edge of 3.16 points; the tester's month from the first session to the fifth reads A's 108 / 102 - 1 = 5.88 per cent less the members' 5.88, -6.12, 14.29 and 0, a mean of 3.51, 2.37 points. At a bar of 7 B is bought as well, and where B leaves the index on the seventh session it is sold at its last close as a member, the sixth's 45, 45 / 49 - 1 = -8.16 per cent.
